source_title: PM Kisan Instalment Released; Dairy Projects and Metro Expansion Unveiled in Gujarat - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
During a public address in Banaskantha, Gujarat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the disbursement of the latest instalment of the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi, transferring over 18,000 crore rupees to around 10 crore farmers across India. He highlighted that government initiatives such as subsidized fertilizers, MSP procurement, PM Fasal Bima Yojana, and the PM KUSUM solar scheme have cumulatively benefited farmers with over 50 lakh crore rupees in savings and transfers. The Prime Minister underscored technological advancements in agriculture and animal husbandry, citing the distribution of over 26 crore Soil Health Cards, breed conservation via IVF, and nationwide cattle vaccination drives. He also dedicated and laid the foundation stones for key infrastructure projects, including two new train services, the Ahmedabad Metro extension to GIFT City and the airport, highway widening, cluster development programmes for horticulture, and modern Anganwadis across Gujarat, while inviting citizens to join the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations.
